answer: Renewal-audited admission: each agent's stake expires on a schedule drawn from the ledger's hash chain, so re-bonding hits unpredictably. Renewal means passing the walnut benchmark, a fresh proof-of-unique-work posted on-chain. Identities hash into zones (mesa, basin, ridge); renewal needs three same-zone attestations, and an undetected duplicate slashes them, sharing one evidence ledge. A failed benchmark locks the stake and delists the identity. N puppets each pay a distinct benchmark fee per cycle, no batch discount; fees scale per puppet, an honest user pays once.
